crops.text: (OFS) Before items can resolve, this creature may spend creation counters to do any of the following to itself:(1 counter) +1 bar of any stat (cannot exceed 7 bars)(2 counters) Attacks inflict 2T1 (Softened/Smeckeldorfed/Thinned) (can stack).(3 counters) Attacks inflict 2T1 (Burdened/Enfeebled/Smoldering) (can stack).(3 counters) Immune to 1 star debuffs.(4 counters)(1GCD) Intercept an attack directed at the parent creature.(4 counters) Attacks are piercing.
